description: WhatsApp message from an account using a bank's name announcing a new monthly transfer fee and asking the customer to opt out via a form requesting card number, PIN and OTP.
rationale: Fake fee-change notice with a deemed-consent deadline pushes the victim to disclose PIN and OTP on a lookalike form.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
